items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Richard M. Jones had once said he thought some of it was from [INTERVIEWEE] Jazz Baby Blues but it's not the same too it's not they were wrong on it

ctx.x: is what I wrote the voice and they added that on to it and they gave Jelly Roll Martin a piece of tune lots of times you hear that Jelly Roll Martin gets grabbed for Millen Boy that's wrong because they played that way down here before they even left that same outfit and like the Tin Root Blues too they claim they stole that well that's not true because they played it way before they left here Georgie did and Paul and Rap they played that blues before they left New Orleans so they couldn't steal that
